jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - AI focused - #1676
jobs.description:
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer with an AI focus to join our technology team in building secure, scalable and user-centric digital solutions that deliver meaningful outcomes for citizens, businesses and public officers.
  
  
You will work across the full software development lifecycle — from solution design and architecture through development, testing, deployment and production support. You will also play a key role in applying Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI and Machine Learning to enhance digital services, automate processes and enable data-driven decision making.
  
  
This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, building production-grade applications and translating emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Full Stack Engineering
  
  
Design, develop and maintain scalable web applications and digital services across the front end and back end.
  
  
Build intuitive, accessible and responsive user interfaces using modern web technologies.
  
  
Develop secure, reliable and well-documented APIs and backend services.
  
  
Design and work with relational and NoSQL databases, data models and integration services.
  
  
Integrate applications with internal systems, government platforms and third-party services.
  
  
Write clean, maintainable, testable and production-ready code.
  
  
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions and engineering best practices.
  
  
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve application performance, reliability and scalability.
  
  
AI / Generative AI
  
  
Design and develop AI-powered features and applications using technologies such as LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, AI agents and Machine Learning.
  
  
Integrate commercial and/or open-source AI models into production applications through APIs and model-serving platforms.
  
  
Build AI workflows involving prompt engineering, retrieval, embeddings, vector databases and knowledge bases.
  
  
Evaluate AI solutions for accuracy, reliability, latency, cost and user experience.
  
  
Implement appropriate safeguards for AI applications, including data protection, access control, human oversight and responsible AI practices.
  
  
Prototype emerging AI technologies and assess their potential for government use cases.
  
  
Work with data, product and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency or citizen services.
  
  
Cloud, DevSecOps & Engineering Excellence
  
  
Develop and deploy applications using modern cloud and container technologies.
  
  
Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring and observability.
  
  
Apply secure software development practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
Ensure solutions comply with relevant government security, data protection, architecture and technology standards.
  
  
Contribute to system architecture, technical documentation and operational readiness.
  
  
Monitor application health, performance and security and participate in incident resolution.
  
  
Collaboration
  
  
Work closely with product managers, UX designers, data scientists, cybersecurity teams and business stakeholders.
  
  
Translate business and user requirements into practical technical solutions.
  
  
Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the development of engineering standards and practices.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  
  
Strong software engineering experience developing production-grade applications.
  
  
Proficiency in one or more backend languages such as Java, Python, C#, Go or Node.js/TypeScript.
  
  
Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue.js.
  
  
Good understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures and system integration.
  
  
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL or MS SQL, and familiarity with NoSQL technologies.
  
  
Experience with Git and modern software development practices, including automated testing and code review.
  
  
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
  
  
Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes is advantageous.
  
  
AI / Data Skills
  
  
Practical experience integrating Generative AI or LLM capabilities into software applications.
  
  
**Understanding of concepts such as:**  
Prompt engineering
  
  
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  
  
Embeddings and vector databases
  
  
LLM APIs and model integration
  
  
AI agents and tool/function calling
  
  
Model evaluation and monitoring
  
  
Experience with AI frameworks or tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel or equivalent is advantageous.
  
  
Familiarity with Python-based AI/ML libraries and frameworks is a plus.
  
  
Understanding of AI security, privacy, governance and responsible AI principles is highly desirable.
  
  
Preferred Experience
  
  
Candidates with experience in one or more of the following will have an advantage:
  
  
Building AI-powered enterprise or government applications.
  
  
Developing citizen-facing or large-scale digital services.
  
  
Working with sensitive or regulated data.
  
  
Cloud-native application development.
  
  
DevSecOps and automated CI/CD.
  
  
Microservices and distributed systems.
  
  
Data engineering, analytics or machine learning.
  
  
Implementing RAG-based enterprise knowledge assistants or AI copilots.
  
  
AI governance, model evaluation, AI security or responsible AI.
  
  
Experience working in a public-sector, regulated or highly secure environment.
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
**Beyond technical skills, we value engineers who:**  
Are curious about emerging AI technologies and able to distinguish practical applications from hype.
  
  
Think systematically and can break complex problems into manageable solutions.
  
  
Take ownership of software quality, security and operational outcomes.
  
  
Care about building technology that creates tangible value for citizens and public officers.
  
  
Are comfortable working in cross-functional and multidisciplinary teams.
  
  
Can balance speed of delivery with maintainability, security and long-term sustainability.
  
  
Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at different levels.
  
  
Have a strong growth mindset and are willing to continuously learn new technologies.
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
**You will have the opportunity to:**  
Build technology that contributes to Singapore's digital government and public services.
  
  
Work on meaningful, high-impact problems affecting citizens and businesses.
  
  
Apply the latest AI and Generative AI technologies to real-world use cases.
  
  
Work alongside experienced engineers, architects, data specialists and product teams.
  
  
Gain exposure to large-scale, secure and mission-critical systems.
  
  
Contribute to the adoption of responsible and trustworthy AI within the public sector.
  
  
Jobster Private Ltd
  
  
At Jobster Private Ltd, we connect great people with great opportunities. As a trusted recruitment and manpower outsourcing partner in Singapore, we support hundreds of professionals like you across industries—from IT and engineering to finance, customer service, and beyond.
  
  
We’re not just about placements—we’re about partnership. Your career matters to us.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
When you join Jobster, you don’t just get a job—you get a team behind you.
  
  
✔ Career Growth Support
  
  
We help you build your career with meaningful roles, skill development opportunities, and guidance along the way.
  
  
✔ Quality Job Openings
  
  
We work with reputable companies offering a wide range of roles in IT, tech support, project management, data analysis, and more.
  
  
✔ Competitive Salaries
  
  
We advocate for you—negotiating fair, competitive salaries and making sure you’re valued for your skills.
  
  
✔ Ongoing Care
  
  
From onboarding to payroll, performance feedback to career advice—we’re with you throughout your journey, not just at the start.
  
  
✔ Trust & Transparency
  
  
Licensed by MOM, certified in data protection, and committed to your success.

jobs.title: IT Manager / Systems Programmer (India & South Asia)
jobs.description:
We arelooking for a highly skilled and hands-on

system programming, software architecture, process automation, database management,and enterprise application development
  
  
.

Set up and manage the company's IT and software development office in India.
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain customized business applications and enterprise systems.
  
  
Automate operational, financial, HR, fleet management, and reporting processes.
  
  
Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable software solutions.

Lead software development projects and manage development teams.
  
  
Develop APIs and integrate third-party applications and platforms.
  
  
Optimize business workflows through automation and digitalization.
  
  
Ensure system security, performance, reliability, and scalability.
  
  
Provide technical leadership and strategic technology planning.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  
  
Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, systems programming, or enterprise application development.
  
  
Proven experience in setting up and managing software development or IT operations teams.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience in system programming and software customization.
  
  
Proficiency in programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, C++, .NET, or equivalent.
  
  
Experience with SQL databases, API development, cloud platforms, and system integration.
  
  
Strong knowledge of ERP, CRM, Transport Management Systems (TMS), and workflow automation.
  
  
Experience in developing and maintaining mission-critical business applications.
  
  
Excellent leadership, project management, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Additional MandatoryRequirements
  
  
Proven experience establishing and managing an offshore IT development centre in India.
  
  
Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and customizing Transport Management Systems (TMS).
  
  
Strong expertise in C#, .NET Framework/.NET Core, SQL Server, API integration, and enterprise application architecture.
  
  
Experience automating transport, fleet management, HR, payroll, finance, and operational workflows.
  
  
Proven track record of integrating ERP, CRM, GPS tracking, telematics, and accounting systems.
  
  
Experience building custom applications from concept to deployment without reliance on third-party vendors.
  
  
Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
  
  
Experience leading teams of software developers, system analysts, and database administrators.
  
  
Ability to travel frequently between India and Singapore.
  
  
Preferred Requirements
  
  
Previous experience in transportation, logistics, fleet management, or mobility businesses.
  
  
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Power BI, and AI-driven automation.
  
  
Experience establishing software development teams in Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Pune.
  
  
Familiarity with Singapore business operations and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Preferred Experience
  
  
Transport, logistics, fleet management, or supply chain industries.
  
  
Enterprise system design and architecture.
  
  
Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, or intelligent automation projects.
  
  
Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, or similar platforms.
  
  
Mobile apps and web application development.
  
  
Key Objective
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to buildan in-house technology capability in India to automate business functions, customizesoftware solutions, integrate systems, improve operational efficiency, andsupport business growth across South Asian markets.
  
  
Remuneration
  
  
Attractive salary package.
  
  
Performance-based incentives.
  
  
Career advancement opportunities.
  
  
Opportunity to build and lead a dedicated technology centre from the ground up.
  
  
Interested candidates should submit a detailed CV highlightingtheir experience in system programming, software development, automationprojects, and IT leadership.
  
  
Special Note
  
  
Only candidates with hands-on experience in systems programming,enterprise software customization, process automation, and setting up softwaredevelopment operations in India will be considered.
